profit_quality.assessment: Low confidence. 2025 annual audited accounts are unavailable; 2025 profit warning only gives PBT not less than HK$38.0m, while 2022-2024 profits were volatile and 2022/2023 free cash flow after capex was negative. The main numerator uses 2025H1 profit and recent cash flow evidence, then applies a 0.45 cash-profit haircut.
adjustments: Used HK$24.0m as pre-haircut sustainable distributable cash profit, close to 2025H1 profit and below 2024 profit.
Did not use rough-screen net profit HK$61.859m as sustainable profit because it matches 2024 audited profit, not audited 2025 annual profit.
Applied 0.45 profit haircut for audit investigation, trading suspension, profit volatility, and uneven free cash flow after capex.
Operating leases were not deducted 100% from cash; lease cash burden is reflected in the cash-profit haircut.
profit_quality.cashflow_support: 2022/2023/2024 OCF less PPE purchases was approximately -HK$4.8m, -HK$10.9m and +HK$59.6m; 2025H1 was +HK$18.1m before full-year audit adjustments.
profit_quality.haircut_reason: 最近三年利润和自由现金流波动较大，2025 年度审计存在海外子公司付款调查，分母必须大幅折价但仍可成立。
profit_quality.cash_conversion_assessment: 经营现金流在 2024 和 2025H1 支撑利润，但 2022/2023 扣资本开支后为负，不能给接近 1 的折扣。
profit_quality.maintenance_capex_assessment: 2022-2024 PPE 购买额分别约 HK$53.1m、HK$32.1m、HK$21.9m，2025H1 约 HK$15.8m，制造业务仍有持续资本开支需求。
profit_quality.working_capital_assessment: 存货和应收为主要经营占款；2024 增加存货 HK$19.4m、应收 HK$16.7m，说明增长需要营运资金。
